tools.name: slug
tools.description: Convert text to a clean, URL-safe slug (unicode/accent aware).

tools.name: ts
tools.description: Convert ISO-8601 timestamp to Unix, or Unix to ISO-8601.

tools.name: case
tools.description: Convert text to camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, PascalCase, UPPER, lower or Title.

tools.name: hash
tools.description: MD5 / SHA-1 / SHA-256 / SHA-512 hex digest of a string.

tools.name: get_api_key
tools.description: Mint a free API key for this server's HTTP API (500 calls/day, no signup). Optional email for usage stats. Pass the key as ?key= on any HTTP endpoint.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_api_key · Private data: get_api_key · Public sink: get_api_key.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_api_key · Private data: get_api_key · Public sink: get_api_key

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
